newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Telecom can top 4,150 escudos.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Telecom can top 4,150 escudos.

text.p: Shares in Portugal Telecom were expected to rise in response to the company's first half results and could top 4,150 escudos per share from Wednesday's closing 4,100 escudos, traders said.

Portugal Telecom posted a first half consolidated profit on Thursday of 23 billion escudos, right in the middle of wide-ranging analysts' forecasts that had gone from 20 billion to 26 billion escudos.
"It is going to gain and it could pass 4,150 escudos," said Jose Freire of Lisbon's Gesfinc.
On Wednesday, Telecom closed higher in New York at $26 7/8, equal to 4,140 escudos, from $26 1/8 on Tuesday.
"The results were good, not spectacularly so, but good. I think the share price can gain between one and 1.5 percent," said Joao Vermelho of Central de Investimentos.
